title: Scale-valued sets: a minimal framework for generalized set models
summary: Many generalized set models have the same basic form: they assign a value to each object, and the main difference lies in the kind of values that are allowed. This paper studies that common form through scale-valued sets (SV-sets), defined as maps $U\times E\toΣ$, where $U$ is a universe, $E$ is a parameter set, and $Σ$ is a bounded De Morgan lattice. With a suitable choice of scale, SV-sets include ordinary sets, fuzzy sets, soft sets, bounded multisets, intuitionistic fuzzy sets, $L$-fuzzy sets, and Type-2 fuzzy sets.
